hints.title: Bounded Search Spectrum
hints.text: Since x + reverse(x) = num and reverse(x) >= 0, the candidate x cannot exceed num.

hints.title: Lower Bound Pruning
hints.text: Furthermore, x must be at least num // 2 because reverse(x) is of roughly similar magnitude.

hints.title: Direct Equation Verification
hints.text: Iterate x from num // 2 to num. Compute reverse(x) and check if x + reverse(x) equals num.

hints.title: Bounded Candidate Check Implementation

complexity.notes: Testing at most num / 2 candidates up to 50,000 iterations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Algebraic equations over digit reversals are non-linear across decimal carries.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) memory checks each candidate in-place.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies upper bound num and scans candidates in linear time.
